lines.text: Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, is among the exiles by the River Kebar when the heavens open.
Ezekiel sees a whirlwind coming from the south, and within its fire is the form of four living creatures.
Each creature has a man's face, with a lion on the right, an ox on the left, and an eagle.
Beside each creature is a wheel within a wheel, and all four rims are full of fingers.
Above the expanse is a sapphire throne with a figure like a man, and Ezekiel falls facedown.
